fields.label: Confirmation Checks
fields.description: Consecutive polls a load/swap/disk reading must stay at-or-above its threshold, with no dip, before an alert fires. Same semantics as Host Monitor Settings' own Confirmation Checks — a poll-count, not a duration, since resource_agent.py's push cadence is independently configurable.

fields.label: Retention (days)
fields.description: Resource Metric Log and Resource Disk Sample rows older than this are purged daily by purge_old_resource_logs. Must be at least Forecast Lookback (days) below, or the forecast window would silently be truncated by its own data's retention.

fields.label: Load Warning (% of cores)
fields.description: 1-minute load average as a percent of this host's CPU core count (e.g. 100% = load average equal to core count, a fully-loaded but not yet overloaded host). Not CPU%, and not compared against Proxmox Guest/Server's own hypervisor-observed CPU usage.

fields.label: Load Critical (% of cores)
fields.description: At/above this (held for Confirmation Checks polls), raises the High Load Average alert.

fields.label: Swap Warning (%)
fields.description: Dashboard display only, colors the tile as a warning — see Critical below for what actually alerts.

fields.label: Swap Critical (%)
fields.description: At/above this (held for Confirmation Checks polls), raises the High Swap Usage alert. Hosts with no swap configured never evaluate this — see Resource Metric Log's swap_total_gb.

fields.label: Disk / Inode Warning (%)
fields.description: Applies to both disk-space and inode fullness on a mount — whichever is higher (max of the two) is compared against this single pair, same approach as Proxmox Server sharing one CPU/RAM threshold pair. Dashboard display only — see Critical below for what actually alerts.

fields.label: Disk / Inode Critical (%)
fields.description: At/above this (held for Confirmation Checks polls), raises a Critical Resource alert on the affected Resource Mount — reusing the same alert_type Proxmox Datastore already uses for a filling storage pool.

fields.label: Forecast Lookback (days)
fields.description: How far back get_disk_forecasts() looks when fitting each mount's growth trend. Must not exceed Retention (days) above.

fields.label: Forecast Minimum Samples
fields.description: A mount with fewer Resource Disk Sample rows than this within the lookback window gets no forecast (insufficient_data) rather than an unreliable one.
